comparator.name: German Language and Culture
comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh2026–2027 official programme-specific OER Article2.9 explicitly specifies German, Dutch and English as instruction/assessment languages. Normalized provider metadata is corrected toNLD+DEU+ENG; rawNLD offering and all permanent identity/provenance remain unchanged. The current guide still assigns the SAME5631VB35Y Kämpfen, beten, schreiben5-EC module to required years1 and2. Its current module is one5-EC course, not two independent units. Counting once retains firstyear60 and secondyear55; the current adopted OER supplies no replacement or applicable double-credit rule. The absence of an authoritative cohort allocation leaves5 EC unresolved. The known third-year20-EC bounded choice is now instantiated as10-EC Alte Neue Welt (first listed literature option) and10-EC Sprachvariation und Ideologien (first listed linguistics option), preserving broad programme pillars by official ordering independently of UCR fit. Their5-EC alternatives are excluded. A literature thesis10 is selected in S2 after the S1 Alte Neue Welt4500-word paper, satisfying the formal semester4/5 written-work rule and at least one10-EC same-discipline choice. Both choice courses are in S1; the guide expressly permits personal third-year plans with different semester EC distributions, so the30-EC open space may coexist with this35/25 split. The compulsory thesis seminar is0 separately and included in thesis10. Required study abroad25 in year2 remains an approved Learning Agreement package at a German-speaking university, with propedeuse/Vertiefung/language-history prerequisites and no invented host-course content. Genuine open30 is preserved; the overlapping German language/culture/history minor is prohibited by Article3.2.9. Known unique credits total60+55+60=175, an explicit partial diagnostic rather than a certified180-EC pathway. OER Article2.2 confirms no named formal routes. Language correction and bounded-choice instantiation do not resolve the missing second-year credit or assess UCR fit.
components: Core Curriculum: Humanities in a Digital World
Krise und Kritik: Literatur von 1914 bis heute
Das Eigene und das Andere: Kulturen, Medien und Identität
Das germanische Sandwich: Deutsch, Niederländisch und English
Kämpfen, beten, schreiben: Literatur von 750 bis 1700
Cultural Memory of World War I & II
Compulsory study at a German-speaking university

Compulsory module5632VBUITY,25 EC in S2 of year2. Host courses at a German-speaking university require an examination-board-approved Learning Agreement and appropriate content/level; retain approved study space without invented host-course names. Entry requires propedeuse plus Vertiefung and Sprache von gestern und heute.
Alte Neue Welt. Europa und Amerika in der deutschsprachigen Literatur

Restricted-choice module5633K003Y (10-EC variant), S1. First listed10-EC literature option; includes a4500-word paper weighted70%, supplying the semester5 written work required before a literature thesis. The5-EC variant5633KAN0Y is mutually exclusive and excluded.

Restricted-choice module5633KSID1Y (10-EC variant), S1. First listed10-EC linguistics option complements literature with a distinct programme pillar. The5-EC variant5633KSID5Y is excluded. Selection follows current official order for broad literature/linguistics coverage independently of UCR fit; no formal specialisation is named.
Bachelor Thesis German Language and Culture

Module5633VB21Y,10 EC including compulsory seminar5633V101Y (0 EC separately). Literature thesis selected in S2 after substantial literature paper in S1/semester5; exact topic and supervision agreed with programme. The first10-EC literature module satisfies the required same-discipline course condition.

Genuine30-EC open electives/minor/internship preserved. The overlapping minor Duitse taal, cultuur en geschiedenis is prohibited under current OER Article3.2.9; no unrelated elective content is invented.
